justification: Both show bearded, profile, low-relief figures in long patterned robes with heavily stylised curled hair, one arm raised and the other holding a handled vessel-like object, alongside rosette/floral ornament and framing horizontal bands \u2014 a fairly specific set of shared conventions. The biggest difference in content is that A depicts long repeated processions of purely human attendants stacked in registers, while B shows a single isolated hybrid bird-headed winged figure attending a large stylised sacred plant.
